mapper.select: SELECT membership.tenant_id, membership.subject_id, membership.membership_id, membership.permission_version FROM organization_access.tenant tenant INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id LEFT JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_authentication_cutover cutover ON cutover.singleton_key IS TRUE LEFT JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle lifecycle ON lifecycle.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id WHERE tenant.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND membership.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND membership.status = 'ENABLED' AND ( (cutover.singleton_key IS NULL AND tenant.status = 'ENABLED') OR (cutover.singleton_key IS TRUE AND lifecycle.status = 'ACTIVE') )
